spec: Pale tile, one ground across the row, product centred at about 60% of tile width. Below it one justified line: 12-14px name left, same-size price right, flush with the tile edges. Optional 11-12px muted descriptor. No button, no badge. 16-24px gutters. The whole tile links.

Tile or model shot with no card chrome. Under it, left-aligned or centred: 13-14px name, 13-14px price, then at most one 12-14px muted line. Reserve three lines of description so prices share a baseline. Outline heart appears top-right on hover only. Six across at 210px, four at 340px.

Flat 3:4 tile in #f2f2f2 or one tone off the page, radius 0, no name, price or badge at rest. Cut-outs alternate with tight detail crops. 10-12px gaps, 12px caps label above the rail, partial tiles at both ends. Use only for a campaign rail that leads to real listings.

Name and price stay small, 13px, and colour carries the card: 12-20px round swatches at about 30px pitch, selected one ringed 2px off the dot, hit area 32px. Hover previews that colour in the tile. A 12px capacity or material line closes it. Fairphone goes large: radius 40, 24px name and price.

4:5 model shot on one studio colour, tiles about 308px with 34px gutters. Under it, 44-48px cut-out product thumbnails as swatches with chevrons at the ends, then centred 16/600 name, 16px descriptor, 19/600 price, stars with count, Compare radio. Hover draws a 1px frame and swaps to a detail shot.

Square warm tile, radius 8, 12px mono tag. 17px name, 16px muted descriptor, then two 13px icon spec rows between 1px rules, then 'From $45 / $2.65 per meal' with the unit price muted, then 32px pill. Swap the rows for one segmented meter or a funding bar when one number decides.

The add control lives on the image. A 64x40 pill sits 12px from the tile's bottom right, always visible, or a dark 30-36px button fades in on hover and stays visible on touch. It adds the default variant without leaving the grid, then shows a tick for 1.5s. Below: 15/500 name, muted line, price.

Tile, name, one muted line, price, then an always-visible button: 30-41px, left-aligned or full width, 1px outlined or solid. Use it where the shopper decides on the card, as with books, single-size goods or a short homepage row. Align every button to one baseline by reserving caption lines.

Everything a big retailer must show, in a fixed order on a 4px rhythm: name, descriptor, price largest at 24-28/700 with superscript cents, stars and count, green or red status dots with place names, variant thumbs, Compare. Round 40px cart button beside the title. Sale in one colour only.

Card radius 24-32 tinted one step off a deep or brand-coloured section, about 348x478, 12-16px gaps, row bleeding past the viewport. Outlined SKU pill, 24-28px name, floating product with small contact shadow, 13px price, one 44-51px pill. Tint comes from the product itself.

No tile or box. A cut-out with a soft contact shadow stands directly on the page ground, about 300px tall, four columns. Centred 14px spec and 16px bold name below. One sticker or a slight rotation carries personality. Needs a clean render and a tinted or cream page.

The grid is a table. 1px ink rules at 25% steps, no fills, no radius. Cell: 11px bold caps name, 11px size line, product, 40-52px square colour chips with 10px names, then a full-width 36px row, bordered on top, with ADD TO CART left and price right. Hover inverts the row.

A set shows what is inside. 1px hairline card, large radius, squircle thumbnail, name, 16px copy, price, 56px arrow disc. Below it a nested tinted panel at about half the outer radius lists contents as small mono chips. Simpler form: a rust 'SET SAVINGS' strip above the image and a struck total.

For rooms, classes and tickets. Photo 4:3 or square, radius 8-20, heart top-right, availability or rating chip. Then 14-15px title, muted place or date, and rate with its unit, such as '$995 / night' or '$18 per class'. Classes add three grey stat tiles. Shows take two 51px buttons, details and book.

The artwork is the card. Square or 4:3 art, radius 2-16, then 14-16px title and 13-14px muted author. A 32px chip at the right holds 'Free' or '$49'. Colour goes on outlines only. Shape can code type, as in square releases and round artists. A single series colour unifies different art.

Product info floats on the picture as a tag. Translucent dark or frosted panel about 290px wide, 8px radius, 48-64px square thumbnail, 12px mono name, price, small arrow, anchored to the thing it names. Noom's version sets a 43px serif price on frosted glass over the bottle. Use for shoppable lookbooks.

Horizontal row for tight spaces. 40-56px thumbnail, 12-14px name, price, then one small add control at the right: 28-32px outlined button or round plus. 1px rule between rows. White Cube's table form runs title, artist, year, price, Purchase. Use in cart drawers, cross-sell and editions lists.

Every tile shares one ground and one framing, so the page reads as a single colour field. 4 columns, tile 3:4 or 4:5, gutters 16-34px, no borders. Ground can be white-grey, studio tan or near black on a cream page. Same crop, same angle, product at about 60% of tile width.

Four 3:4 images butted with 1px gaps on 24px page margins, or full bleed with 4px gaps, no card chrome. Model and still-life tiles mix under one studio ground. Captions sit on the page below at 12px, inset 12px. Ends in one small black 'show more'. Reads as a printed contact sheet.

Columns are drawn, not gapped. 1px solid or dashed rules between cells, no fills, cell padding 20-32px, rules running full bleed to the page edges. Small caps label top-left of each cell, product, then caption low in the cell. Works from 3 to 5 columns at 10-25% ink.

A 3-4 column product grid broken on a fixed beat. Every 8th to 12th cell is a lifestyle photo spanning 1x2 with the row flowing round it, and every 9 to 12 products a full-width band carries a guarantee or story. Page uses numbered pagination with a back-to-top pill. Never interrupt the first row.

Full-bleed lifestyle panels that route by category. 2-4 across, 0-8px gaps, radius 0-10, 420-900px tall. White label bottom-left at 14-24px with one short descriptor, over a bottom scrim only. No arrows or counts. Arc'teryx sets four above the filter bar and underlines the active one.

Grouped product cut-outs stand for a category. Four columns, tile #f8f8f8 or none, 24px gaps, radius 0-8, object at about 65% of tile height with a soft cast shadow. Label under the object, 14-24px, tracked caps or a quiet serif, plus an optional 14px line. No button.

A row of small thumbnails directly under the header routes before any grid. 8 items at about 154px radius 10, or 5 circles at 135px, gap 24, centred 13-16px labels. Crop tight on a texture, face or object. Turns into a swipeable rail with a peek on phones.

One row that bleeds past the page edge. Five and a half tiles at 1-16px gaps, or a 350px text column beside portrait tiles with the third peeking. Heading left, 'Show all' right, arrows only on hover or in the text column, dash pagers at 28x3px on phones. Peek at least 40px.

Few products, each given a tall column to compare. 2-4 columns, 20px gap, about 400x880, tinted fill, newest in a gradient. Product top at 70-80% of column width, 28-34px name, 17-22px one-line descriptor, 'From $' price, one 40-44px button, centred. Apple bleeds white cards radius 28 on #f5f5f7.

No grid at all. Each product gets one viewport on its own ground, black or grey or a colour per line, product centred, a tiny 9-12px mono label bottom-left, two buttons at most. Scroll steps between stages, with a small index to jump. For catalogues under about 12 products.

Objects of different heights stand on one shelf line. 3-5 columns, 24-40px gutters, no tile, items aligned to the bottom of the image cell with a soft book shadow. Centred caption: 12px tag, 12-25px title, price. A count or 'Show All' outline button closes it. Ideal for books and bottles.

A small shop sits next to one big picture. Left half a macro or lifestyle photo, or a pale panel with one book at 50% width. Right half: 'New in' label, 22px title, price, text link, or a 3-column grid of cut-outs. For culture, wine and editorial sites selling a few things.

A catalogue of digital things. Art fills each thumbnail, so the grid needs no tile: 3-4 columns, 16:10 or 4:3, gaps 20px by 74px with meta in the row gap, radius 0-16, faint 1px edge on dark art. 14px title, 13px muted line. Ends in Load More.

Text-first listing for software and plugins. 2 columns of 558x186 cards, gap 24, radius 12, 1px line. 32px icon, 16/600 name, 34px ghost Install at right, 15px description clamped to 2 lines, 13px meta row of avatar, author, count and installs. Sets a directory apart from a shop.

Stores, stays and shows. 3-4 column photo grid at one consistent 4:3 crop, 16px gutters, tabs for city above, 'View all' at the right. Caption triple: title, place, date, with place and date muted. Hover colours only the title. A location page needs an address and hours, not a price.

How a listing opens. Either a compact 28-48px title with a one-line intro and the filter bar in the first viewport, or an image-led band with an 80px light title beside a tall photo. Keep product visible above the fold on a phone. Never open with a full-screen banner.

One row above the grid so the grid keeps full width. Result count first at 15-20px, then 13-16/500 dropdown triggers with small chevrons split by 22px hairlines, Sort pinned right, 1px rule under. Applied filters repeat as removable chips. Sticks on scroll. Best for 3-8 facets.

A tinted tray holds the filters as objects: 54px tall, radius 8, 6px padding, 42px white chips radius 4 with chevrons at 6px gaps. Chips carry tiny previews of their content, such as a colour strip. Far right: count badge and Reset. For browsing galleries with many facets.

Pills switch category, each a real page. 24-30px tall, 999px or small radius, 12-13px, 1px outline, active filled ink. Centred under a 28px title or left under a large one, Sort on the same row at right. Scrolls sideways on phones with the row bleeding off the edge.

Two jobs, two controls. Category pills on top, then one row between rules: 'Filter by +' left, product count centred, 'Sort by' right. Filter opens a drawer, so the grid keeps four columns. Our Place leads with an outlined FILTER button at 32px beside 30px pills. Ulta keeps the launcher sticky.

40px pill row, 1px line, 15px semibold, active filled, right edge fades into a round arrow. On scroll the row moves up and docks inside the 64px header between logo and account, so it never takes a second sticky line. For feeds and content catalogues.

Left rail 180-240px, no card. Rows 48px between 1px rules, 14px/600 labels, chevron right, most facets collapsed. Open lists use 18px checkboxes, 14px labels and muted result counts at right. Two-state facets show count and checkbox inline. Best past 8 facets or for spec-driven buying.

Wide 300-400px facet panel for huge catalogues. 12px grey group labels, wrapped chips 6-8px radius with small tinted icons and 13-14px text, '+N' overflow chip, dual-handle slider with tick labels. Shows the taxonomy at a glance and each click filters at once.

Pill chips with a 24-28px product thumbnail, 48px tall, radius 64, 14px text, on a pale fill, in one sideways-scrolling row above the title or grid. Names the types in shopper language, so a first visitor can pick without knowing the facets.

Filtering set as plain text. One centred 32px serif sentence of comma-separated categories, or ALL and STYLE at 13px on a rule one tile wide, or 12px header links with the active one underlined. For editorial sites and small catalogues under 30 items. Never for large ranges.

The full taxonomy on show in place of a sidebar. Up to ten columns across 1200px, 14px head over four 14/26 muted links. Directories can add a 30px search, a 13-wide A-Z strip of 20px squares and stacked selects. Good when people arrive knowing the name.

One row across the grid width. Left, a capsule of 3 text tabs with the active one a lit pill. Right, a 42px segment of platform glyphs beside a 320px search with its shortcut hint. For app stores and extension directories, where type and platform are the only decisions.

Default product page. Image 55-58% of width, sticky, tile fill or photo. Buy box about 480px: 30px title, stars with linked count, 24px price, instalment line, option groups, 50px full-width add button, delivery line, three-part trust row. Thumbs 48-64px beside or below the image.

Info column first, 400px, sticky at left. 32/500 title, rating, tag, 34px joined size chips, purchase radios between ink rules, 40px add button holding the price, short copy. Two tall images 460x570 fill the rest, 15px apart, with 50px thumbs below. Feels like a magazine spread.

For considered purchases. Left a sticky 870x560 stage, radius 20, one tone off the page. Right a 330px column of steps, each a 28px heading with dark lead and muted continuation, over option tiles radius 12. Later steps stay dimmed until the earlier ones are chosen. Dot progress on the right edge.

One-time versus subscribe as two rows. Each 48-52px, bordered or between rules, radio left, price right, saving in a small tag. The chosen row expands to show cadence and 3-4 benefit lines, ending with skip or cancel any time. The add button total follows the choice.

When options differ in price or format, use tiles, not a dropdown. 2-4 tiles 170x108, radius 8, tiny caps merit label such as Most Popular, option name below, selected tile takes a 2px accent border and pale fill. Books use a table of formats with prices beside one buy button.

The contents are the pitch. Square photo left, 656px info right: 40px title, stars, 24/700 price, bold lead, 16px copy, rule, tracked 'SET INCLUDES' label, then 70px bordered thumbnails at 76px pitch with name and one line each. Closes with a 56px full-width button holding the price.

One object as a theatre set. Product centred or diagonal at 430-700px on a ground that changes with each colourway. Neighbours sit either side as low-alpha outlines with only the dial or blade coloured. Selected colour named beside small dots. PREVIOUS and NEXT at the edges in 12px mono. One clear action.

No price, no cart. Per piece: 14px description, then a 'Dimensions' label indented about 60px with figures beneath. Set in an index column beside a tall photograph, one enquiry link at the end. Fits antiques, furniture, architecture and made-to-order, where the conversation is the sale.

Buy without a product page. Single-product sites and home pages carry the box in place: rounded 20px media beside a 52px headline, price, delivery chips and one pill. Quick view does the same in a right panel with accordion details. Must still show variants and shipping.

Appears once the main button scrolls off. Desktop: 760x90 white bar centred 16px from the bottom, 1px line, soft shadow, 64px thumb, 24px name, 13px sub, 200x53 button with price. Phone: full-width, 44px thumb, name, button. Hidden while the real button is on screen.

Long detail folded under the buy box. Plus-minus rows 44-52px between 1px rules, 13-14px labels: Details, Care, Dimensions, Shipping, Returns. First row open. Rule colour ink at full strength reads premium, at 10% reads quiet. Shipping and returns must be one tap away.

Answers fear at the button. Directly under add to cart: stock dot with ship date, free shipping threshold, returns window, then a three-part icon row. Harney adds a verified quote in a 490px rounded card beside the title. Keep to four facts, each one specific.

After the buy box and in the drawer. Four cards in a row with a heading such as 'Goes with', arrows top-right, radius matching the page, or compact 56px thumb rows with a small outlined add button so a shopper can add without leaving. Show real pairs, never the item itself.

Right drawer 420-480px, full width on phones, over a 40% scrim. Fixed header with count, shipping progress line, scrolling lines with 88px thumb, name, variant, 32px stepper, line price, Remove. Fixed footer: subtotal, 'tax and shipping at checkout', delivery date, 52px Checkout. Updates in place.

Full cart page: lines at 120px thumbs on the left between 1px rules, sticky 380px summary on the right with subtotal, shipping, tax, total at 18/500, collapsed promo field, 52px Checkout, delivery date and returns line. On phones the summary follows the lines and Checkout pins to the bottom.

An empty drawer that routes. About 422px on warm off-white: 48px header, 24/36 two-line message, 11px caps label, then five 374x66 outlined rows radius 4 with a 48px cut-out and 14px label at 16px gaps, then a pinned 48px outlined 'Shop all'. Allbirds stacks black pills instead.

An empty drawer with a personality. About 435px, 60% grey scrim, 40px header holding BAG (0), free shipping line with a thin progress rule, a tinted body, 20px two-line message in the brand's voice, one large pale brand mark, 'Shop all' pinned at the base. Use only when the voice is real.

Free shipping progress as the drawer's headline: 12-13px line over a thin rounded bar. Empty state centres one display headline, one line and a 48px pill. A pinned bottom rail holds 304x98 upsell cards with thumb, name, price and a 32px round plus, with arrows, so adding never leaves the drawer.

Wide 600px drawer used as a small shop. 'Your Cart (0)' at 20px serif, ink rule, plain continue-shopping and sign-in links, then 'Recommended For You' with two horizontal cards: 100px grey thumb, 11-12/700 caps name, colour line, price, and a 41px full-width dark ADD TO BAG.

Empty cart as a real page. 40/600 headline, one line offering sign-in, two 360x56 buttons, a hairline help strip, then a 980px promo tile with product art. Parachute keeps it shorter: a sign-in nudge, then newsletter and footer. Never a dead page with an illustration and nothing to do.

For configured or financed goods. Sticky 74px strip: product name left, right-aligned two-line 17px price with footnote marks, updating as options change. A 50px strip under it splits delivery, shipping and pickup with hairlines. The answer to 'what am I at now' never leaves the screen.

A one-step checkout for giving. 390px white panel on a photo. Two-segment frequency toggle, then 116x52 amount chips in 3 columns with 'Other amount' spanning two, selected chip in the accent, one line stating what that amount does, then one 48px full-width button.
